profile.name: Ella
profile.title: Front End Developer
profile.bio:
I am a web developer with a love for building front-end interactive experiences and games.
 I enjoy experimenting with new technologies.

 AR/VR enthusiast.

projects.name: Train Simulator
projects.description: A train simulator game built with Three.js, assisted by AI. The game allows you to drive a train, stop at stations and pick up passengers. (best played using a throttle and joystick controller)

experience.description:
Building and shipping web applications. Creating interactive websites and experiences for various clients. 
 Consultancy for a number of Antwerp based agencies.

In my initial role at Elia, I was responsible for updating their matterport 3d scans, scanning new buildings and integrating interactive elements into the scans. Later on, I was part of the IoT team where I built interactive dashboards and websites for visualizing and controlling IoT devices.
